text: Since expanding the length of the drop-off and pick-up zone for the St. Michael and All Angel's Church Daycare Centre, located at 611 St. Clair Avenue West, the administration has advised me that the programming hours have expanded so a change to the hours of operation for the zone is required.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Re-opened Item TE30.71 entitled "Parking Amendments – Wychwood Avenue" with respect to Recommendation 2. 2. Deleted Recommendation 2 and replaced it with the following new Recommendation 2: "2. Toronto and East York Community Council amend the existing ten-minute maximum parking limit in effect from 7:30 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Wychwood Avenue, between a point 30.5 metres south of St. Clair Avenue West (west intersection) and Ellsworth Avenue, to be in effect from 7:30 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Wychwood Avenue, between a point 15 metres south of St. Clair Avenue West (west intersection) and a point 22 metres further south."
